{{Top|Imp}}
'''Transfinite hyperspatial mathematics''' was a field of mathematical study, which also had direct ties to the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] culture due to their advanced mathematics background. The notorious [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Chrag'mak'al]] who operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], once had been a priest in the religion of his people and an expert in this field.<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
